title: The house of Ide
description: How the house is ordered: the two councils, the grades of life, the temple, the king.
html:
THE HOUSE

The order

IdeWhat it isWhat it means
Omunnathe council of male eldersthe collective male elders of a kindred.
Omuadathe council of female eldersthe daughters of the house.
Omuazithe first gradebirth to six: immersion, Odiana rituals, care, no labour.
Ndosethe templethe sacred space, and everything built around it.
Ikalathe kinghalf human, half spirit, hailed Ezeana.
